verdict.rationale: The official support docs say llamafile ships GPU acceleration for Apple Metal, NVIDIA, AMD and Vulkan, and a community user confirms GPU support. However, the author notes Windows users need dev tools (CUDA/MSVC) installed for GPU performance. One user's CUDA compilation failed and fell back to CPU, and another saw processing stay mostly on the CPU. missing for 10: in-depth docs on per-vendor kernels and setup, GPU acceleration that works without extra toolkits, independent confirmation that AMD/Vulkan acceleration works in practice.
